public.text: A goal is said to be validated “in the same way as a component.” Component conformance and outcome achievement are fundamentally different forms of evidence and should not be treated as equivalent.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace “in the same way” with: “using an analogous traceability pattern.” Clearly distinguish technical verification from programme evaluation and health-outcome assessment.
